returnInterest.note: Maybe if I happened to be in the area, mainly to see more of the forests and mountains.

description.intro: Liechtenstein is a small country between Austria and Switzerland known for its mountain scenery, wealthy atmosphere, and unique history. I found it easy to explore in a short amount of time, and the landscapes were the highlight of my visit. Although I am not planning a dedicated return trip, I would not mind coming back if I were nearby.
standouts: The mountains and hills were beautiful.
I found the country's history interesting.
It was easy to travel through in a single day.
It felt even more expensive than Switzerland.
tips: I would recommend taking bus route 11 between Sargans (Switzerland) and Feldkirch (Austria), as it passes through most of the country and is an efficient way to explore it.
The ruins up on the mountain behind the castle in Vaduz are worth visiting for the views and the hike.
thingsToKnow: The country can only be reached through nearby cities by train, bus, or car.
It is very narrow and can be crossed in a relatively straight line.
Liechtenstein is known for having the highest GDP per capita in the world, at around €194,715 in 05/2026.
culturalNotes: The overall atmosphere felt very wealthy.
personalNotes: There were a lot of expensive and rare cars driving around.
I found it interesting that several villas were divided into multiple addresses like an apartment building.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I didn't need a visa to enter.
transportNotes: There is no airport in Liechtenstein.
You can reach the country through nearby cities in Switzerland or Austria.
Bus route 11 between Sargans and Feldkirch passes through almost every town in Liechtenstein and takes around 82 minutes.
There is also a train station in Schaan with connections to Feldkirch in Austria and Buchs in Switzerland.
languageNotes: Most people seemed to be able to speak English.

notes: The weather was pleasant, although cooler than in the surrounding countries.
